SC-01.text:
SC / MY DAY
SC-01 Start the day and prioritise work
Sales caller / Own assigned prospects / illustrated in the preceding screen
FINVERSE WEALTH / CRM INTERFACE PROPOSAL / 26 SEP 2026
044
USER ACTION
01
Review overdue, promised callbacks and new lead
deadlines.
02
Open a priority row to enter that prospect record.
03
Mark availability for allocation; this never changes the login
role.
BEFORE IT CAN PROCEED
Current active assignment is mandatory. Availability uses approved hours and absence status; it
does not change ownership.
SYSTEM COMMIT
Load own tasks, lead counts and reminders with an as-of timestamp. Record availability changes
with effective time.
REPORTING CONSEQUENCE
My day shows operational workload. Personal performance keeps the historical team and role for
each event.
IF IT CANNOT COMPLETE
No active assignment: show access pending. A delayed provider shows a stale-data badge, not
zero calls.
Implementation contract proposal. Approval limits, product evidence and commercial definitions need Finverse confirmation.

SC-02.text:
SC / LEAD INBOX
SC-02 Filter, search and save a lead view
Sales caller / Own assigned prospects / illustrated in the preceding screen
FINVERSE WEALTH / CRM INTERFACE PROPOSAL / 26 SEP 2026
046
USER ACTION
01
Choose stage, due date, source and product filters.
02
Select Apply filters; view only owned results and permitted
contact fields.
03
Save view with a name or Reset to the default inbox.
BEFORE IT CAN PROCEED
Search, counts and suggestions must obey ownership scope. Saved views store filters, never a
reusable copy of customer data.
SYSTEM COMMIT
Run a paginated scoped query. Store the employee-specific view definition and reapply current
permissions each time.
REPORTING CONSEQUENCE
Changing a filter changes the displayed slice only. It never changes lead attribution or report
definitions.
IF IT CANNOT COMPLETE
No match: show an empty state and Clear filters. Another caller lead ID returns no exposed
customer information.
Implementation contract proposal. Approval limits, product evidence and commercial definitions need Finverse confirmation.

SC-03.text:
SC / LEAD INBOX
SC-03 Open a prospect and inspect the full record
Sales caller / Own assigned prospects / illustrated in the preceding screen
FINVERSE WEALTH / CRM INTERFACE PROPOSAL / 26 SEP 2026
048
USER ACTION
01
Open a lead from the inbox or a valid notification.
02
Use Summary, Timeline, Tasks, Documents and Outcome
tabs.
03
Select Call, WhatsApp or Add activity from the prospect
header.
BEFORE IT CAN PROCEED
The opportunity must belong to the current permitted workload. Contact links expose only
enquiries the caller may see.
SYSTEM COMMIT
Fetch opportunity and scoped related records. Show provenance, ownership history, permissions
and outstanding tasks.
REPORTING CONSEQUENCE
Viewing a record is not a contact activity and adds no sales credit. Sensitive document access is
separately audited.
IF IT CANNOT COMPLETE
Reassigned while open: show a read-only access-changed message, clear sensitive fields and
return to the inbox.
Implementation contract proposal. Approval limits, product evidence and commercial definitions need Finverse confirmation.

SC-04.text:
SC / LEAD INBOX
SC-04 Correct prospect information
Sales caller / Own assigned prospects / illustrated in the preceding screen
FINVERSE WEALTH / CRM INTERFACE PROPOSAL / 26 SEP 2026
050
USER ACTION
01
Select Edit details from the prospect record.
02
Update allowed fields and explain the correction.
03
Save changes; protected identity changes go to verification
or a review queue.
BEFORE IT CAN PROCEED
Validate phone/email format and possible duplicate identity. Caller cannot change source
attribution, vertical or ownership.
SYSTEM COMMIT
Save permitted values with record-version checking. Append before/after audit and retain original
intake provenance.
REPORTING CONSEQUENCE
A correction does not create a new lead or improve contact counts. Contact permission remains a
separate record.
IF IT CANNOT COMPLETE
Possible duplicate: pause the identity change and submit a review. Never merge customer
records automatically from this form.
Implementation contract proposal. Approval limits, product evidence and commercial definitions need Finverse confirmation.

SC-05.text:
SC / LEAD INBOX
SC-05 Create a permitted self-sourced enquiry
Sales caller / Own assigned prospects / illustrated in the preceding screen
FINVERSE WEALTH / CRM INTERFACE PROPOSAL / 26 SEP 2026
052
USER ACTION
01
Select New enquiry if the role grant enables manual creation.
02
Capture source, need and contact-permission evidence.
03
Submit enquiry to validation; receive its processing
reference.
BEFORE IT CAN PROCEED
Role permission, mandatory fields and source evidence are required. Run duplicate checks
before making a new opportunity.
SYSTEM COMMIT
Store manual intake separately with origin and creator. Publish through normal routing;
self-ownership is not assumed.
REPORTING CONSEQUENCE
Source credit and sales ownership are separate. Invalid or duplicate intake is reported explicitly,
not as fresh sales work.
IF IT CANNOT COMPLETE
Existing enquiry: link or send for duplicate review. Missing permission keeps the record out of
outbound contact queues.
Implementation contract proposal. Approval limits, product evidence and commercial definitions need Finverse confirmation.

SC-06.text:
SC / CONVERSATIONS
SC-06 Place a voice call
Sales caller / Own assigned prospects / illustrated in the preceding screen
FINVERSE WEALTH / CRM INTERFACE PROPOSAL / 26 SEP 2026
054
USER ACTION
01
Select Call after reviewing prospect context and channel
eligibility.
02
During the call use Mute, Unmute and End call; each shows
current call state.
03
After the call open mandatory wrap-up; record the actual
result.
BEFORE IT CAN PROCEED
Check assigned owner, contact permission, working hours, frequency cap and provider health
before placing the call.
SYSTEM COMMIT
Request one provider call with an idempotency key. Show connecting, ringing, connected, ended
or failed states.
REPORTING CONSEQUENCE
Only unique provider-confirmed calls count as verified attempts. Connected duration comes from
provider evidence.
IF IT CANNOT COMPLETE
Provider unavailable: offer Retry or a labelled manual activity. Repeated button clicks must not
start duplicate calls.
Implementation contract proposal. Approval limits, product evidence and commercial definitions need Finverse confirmation.

SC-07.text:
SC / CONVERSATIONS
SC-07 Complete call wrap-up and next action
Sales caller / Own assigned prospects / illustrated in the preceding screen
FINVERSE WEALTH / CRM INTERFACE PROPOSAL / 26 SEP 2026
056
USER ACTION
01
Choose Connected, No answer, Busy, Wrong number or
Callback.
02
Record the conversation result and required next step.
03
Save wrap-up; move to the next eligible lead only after the
save succeeds.
BEFORE IT CAN PROCEED
Connected alone does not prove qualified need. Follow-up needs a due time and owner.
No-answer cannot set Contacted.
SYSTEM COMMIT
Append activity and allowed stage event. Create/update the next task atomically and close the
completed task.
REPORTING CONSEQUENCE
Call facts use call-start date. Stage and task completion use their own event times; a repeated
save counts once.
IF IT CANNOT COMPLETE
Uncertain outcome: keep the call in Needs wrap-up. Unsaved notes stay in a recoverable draft
with an expiry policy.
Implementation contract proposal. Approval limits, product evidence and commercial definitions need Finverse confirmation.

SC-08.text:
SC / CONVERSATIONS
SC-08 Record a manual call with clear evidence status
Sales caller / Own assigned prospects / illustrated in the preceding screen
FINVERSE WEALTH / CRM INTERFACE PROPOSAL / 26 SEP 2026
058
USER ACTION
01
Open Add activity and choose Manual call.
02
Enter actual event time, reason, outcome and next action.
03
Save as a manual entry; submit any required supervisor
verification.
BEFORE IT CAN PROCEED
Allow only a configured backdating window. Do not accept a future call time or fabricate a
provider call ID.
SYSTEM COMMIT
Store actor, entered time, event time and manual verification status. Link follow-up and preserve
edit history.
REPORTING CONSEQUENCE
Show manual activity separately from verified call volume. Supervisor approval does not turn it
into a provider event.
IF IT CANNOT COMPLETE
Duplicate suspected: flag for TL review. Incorrect saved entries use a correction, not silent
deletion.
Implementation contract proposal. Approval limits, product evidence and commercial definitions need Finverse confirmation.

SC-09.text:
SC / CONVERSATIONS
SC-09 Send an approved WhatsApp message
Sales caller / Own assigned prospects / illustrated in the preceding screen
FINVERSE WEALTH / CRM INTERFACE PROPOSAL / 26 SEP 2026
060
USER ACTION
01
Open WhatsApp from the prospect and choose an eligible
template or allowed reply.
02
Review merged variables and recipient before Send.
03
Read queued, delivered, read, replied or failed status in the
same conversation.
BEFORE IT CAN PROCEED
Check current provider policy, eligible product, permission, conversation window, template
approval and opt-out before sending.
SYSTEM COMMIT
Create one outbound message, store provider ID and reconcile signed delivery callbacks.
Suppress queued outreach on opt-out.
REPORTING CONSEQUENCE
Sent or delivered is not successful contact. A meaningful customer response can support contact
with an activity record.
IF IT CANNOT COMPLETE
Template unavailable or permission missing: disable Send with a reason. Use a secure document
link for sensitive information.
Implementation contract proposal. Approval limits, product evidence and commercial definitions need Finverse confirmation.

SC-10.text:
SC / CONVERSATIONS
SC-10 Handle an inbound reply or missed call
Sales caller / Own assigned prospects / illustrated in the preceding screen
FINVERSE WEALTH / CRM INTERFACE PROPOSAL / 26 SEP 2026
062
USER ACTION
01
Open an unread conversation assigned to your workload.
02
Read prior context, answer within permitted channel rules
and update the task.
03
Mark handled only after recording the response or next
action.
BEFORE IT CAN PROCEED
Resolve ambiguous enquiry matches without exposing other vertical conversations. Unowned
replies route to a supervisor queue.
SYSTEM COMMIT
Deduplicate inbound event IDs. Append message to the right enquiry and notify its current owner
or accountable queue.
REPORTING CONSEQUENCE
Track first response and unresolved inbound age separately from outbound attempt counts.
IF IT CANNOT COMPLETE
Ownership changed: route to the new owner. Never leave an inbound message assigned to a
disabled account.
Implementation contract proposal. Approval limits, product evidence and commercial definitions need Finverse confirmation.

SC-11.text:
SC / CALENDAR & TASKS
SC-11 Schedule a follow-up
Sales caller / Own assigned prospects / illustrated in the preceding screen
FINVERSE WEALTH / CRM INTERFACE PROPOSAL / 26 SEP 2026
064
USER ACTION
01
Select Schedule follow-up from the lead or call wrap-up.
02
Pick date, time, action, purpose and reminder.
03
Save; the task appears in My calendar and the lead timeline.
BEFORE IT CAN PROCEED
Require future due time, current owner and an eligible channel. Warn about conflicts and
outside-hours appointments.
SYSTEM COMMIT
Create a versioned task and reminder job. Mark Follow-up stage if the transition is allowed.
REPORTING CONSEQUENCE
The task enters the due-period denominator. Committed deadline and any later revision remain
traceable.
IF IT CANNOT COMPLETE
Duplicate open task for the same purpose: offer Update existing or explicitly confirm a separate
task.
Implementation contract proposal. Approval limits, product evidence and commercial definitions need Finverse confirmation.

SC-12.text:
SC / CALENDAR & TASKS
SC-12 Reschedule a promised callback
Sales caller / Own assigned prospects / illustrated in the preceding screen
FINVERSE WEALTH / CRM INTERFACE PROPOSAL / 26 SEP 2026
066
USER ACTION
01
Open the due task and select Reschedule.
02
Enter the new time and a specific reason.
03
Save and send an eligible confirmation if selected.
BEFORE IT CAN PROCEED
Keep the original deadline. Repeated deferrals or overdue moves may require TL approval under
the configured threshold.
SYSTEM COMMIT
Append schedule revision, cancel obsolete reminder jobs and create replacements. Retain
original SLA history.
REPORTING CONSEQUENCE
Rescheduling never erases a missed commitment. Show revised workload and original on-time
performance separately.
IF IT CANNOT COMPLETE
Approval required: keep the old committed deadline active until the change is approved; display
both dates clearly.
Implementation contract proposal. Approval limits, product evidence and commercial definitions need Finverse confirmation.

SC-13.text:
SC / CALENDAR & TASKS
SC-13 Complete, cancel or reopen a task
Sales caller / Own assigned prospects / illustrated in the preceding screen
FINVERSE WEALTH / CRM INTERFACE PROPOSAL / 26 SEP 2026
068
USER ACTION
01
Open the task and choose Complete, Request cancellation or
Reopen correction.
02
Record the result and next action for an open opportunity.
03
Save; return to the calendar with the updated task state.
BEFORE IT CAN PROCEED
Completion must have a truthful outcome. Cancellation needs an allowed reason; reopen after
finalisation is a logged correction.
SYSTEM COMMIT
Write task transition and linked activity once. Cancel reminders for terminal tasks and create the
next task where needed.
REPORTING CONSEQUENCE
Eligible due tasks remain in the follow-up metric. Approved cancellations are excluded and
reported separately.
IF IT CANNOT COMPLETE
A task moved to another owner cannot be completed from a stale caller screen.
Implementation contract proposal. Approval limits, product evidence and commercial definitions need Finverse confirmation.

SC-14.text:
SC / CALENDAR & TASKS
SC-14 Book a prospect meeting or visit
Sales caller / Own assigned prospects / illustrated in the preceding screen
FINVERSE WEALTH / CRM INTERFACE PROPOSAL / 26 SEP 2026
070
USER ACTION
01
Select Book meeting and inspect available authorised slots.
02
Confirm attendees, location and agenda.
03
Book the slot and issue eligible invitations; record attended,
no-show or cancelled later.
BEFORE IT CAN PROCEED
Check slot conflicts, attendee access and product-specific requirements. External
communication needs an approved channel.
SYSTEM COMMIT
Reserve the slot atomically, create attendee tasks and queue invitation delivery with separate
delivery status.
REPORTING CONSEQUENCE
Track booked, attended and no-show counts separately. Booking alone is not conversion.
IF IT CANNOT COMPLETE
Slot taken during save: show alternative slots. Failed invitation does not silently cancel an already
reserved appointment.
Implementation contract proposal. Approval limits, product evidence and commercial definitions need Finverse confirmation.

SC-15.text:
SC / MY PIPELINE
SC-15 Qualify the opportunity
Sales caller / Own assigned prospects / illustrated in the preceding screen
FINVERSE WEALTH / CRM INTERFACE PROPOSAL / 26 SEP 2026
072
USER ACTION
01
Open Qualification from the prospect record.
02
Complete the product-specific checklist and record
customer needs.
03
Save qualification; use the recommended next action inside
the permitted pipeline.
BEFORE IT CAN PROCEED
Mandatory qualification fields depend on the configured product. An estimate cannot be entered
as verified revenue.
SYSTEM COMMIT
Persist answers with checklist version and append activity. Suggest the next milestone without
auto-approving a sale.
REPORTING CONSEQUENCE
Show qualification completion and estimated pipeline separately from verified outcomes.
IF IT CANNOT COMPLETE
Product mismatch: request an approved referral. The caller cannot change the lead into another
vertical.
Implementation contract proposal. Approval limits, product evidence and commercial definitions need Finverse confirmation.

SC-16.text:
SC / MY PIPELINE
SC-16 Move an opportunity in the pipeline
Sales caller / Own assigned prospects / illustrated in the preceding screen
FINVERSE WEALTH / CRM INTERFACE PROPOSAL / 26 SEP 2026
074
USER ACTION
01
Drag a card or choose Change stage for an owned
opportunity.
02
Complete the transition form shown for the target stage.
03
Confirm; return the card to its original stage if the server
rejects the change.
BEFORE IT CAN PROCEED
Server validates the allowed state transition, ownership and required fields. Converted always
follows approval rules.
SYSTEM COMMIT
Append a stage event with prior state, actor, reason and rule version. Update related tasks in the
same transaction.
REPORTING CONSEQUENCE
Stage counts and ageing refresh from authoritative events. Dragging a card without saving
changes no metrics.
IF IT CANNOT COMPLETE
Stale record: show the newer stage and request review. A UI drag cannot bypass a locked or
rejected milestone.
Implementation contract proposal. Approval limits, product evidence and commercial definitions need Finverse confirmation.

SC-17.text:
SC / MY PIPELINE
SC-17 Prepare and send a proposal
Sales caller / Own assigned prospects / illustrated in the preceding screen
FINVERSE WEALTH / CRM INTERFACE PROPOSAL / 26 SEP 2026
076
USER ACTION
01
Select Prepare proposal and populate approved product
information.
02
Preview terms and any exception requiring superior
approval.
03
Submit for approval or Send approved proposal through an
eligible channel.
BEFORE IT CAN PROCEED
No unapproved return claims, altered mandatory terms or discounts outside authority. Required
disclosures come from approved content.
SYSTEM COMMIT
Version the proposal, store approval evidence and log send status. Preserve earlier versions as
read-only.
REPORTING CONSEQUENCE
Proposal sent is a pipeline milestone, not won revenue. Report pending commercial approvals
separately.
IF IT CANNOT COMPLETE
Expired or withdrawn product content blocks sending. An approved proposal edited afterward
must be approved again.
Implementation contract proposal. Approval limits, product evidence and commercial definitions need Finverse confirmation.

SC-18.text:
SC / DOCUMENTS
SC-18 Request documents securely
Sales caller / Own assigned prospects / illustrated in the preceding screen
FINVERSE WEALTH / CRM INTERFACE PROPOSAL / 26 SEP 2026
078
USER ACTION
01
Open Documents and select the approved checklist.
02
Generate a secure upload request and preview the customer
message.
03
Send via an eligible channel and monitor pending items.
BEFORE IT CAN PROCEED
Only request permitted documents for this product and stage. Do not request full sensitive
identifiers inside chat.
SYSTEM COMMIT
Issue scoped upload tokens, store expiry and link evidence to the opportunity. Scan uploaded
files before release.
REPORTING CONSEQUENCE
Document completeness is operational progress. An uploaded file is not automatically verified.
IF IT CANNOT COMPLETE
Expired link can be replaced after permission checking. A suspicious file stays quarantined and
unavailable to users.
Implementation contract proposal. Approval limits, product evidence and commercial definitions need Finverse confirmation.

SC-19.text:
SC / DOCUMENTS
SC-19 Upload, replace or inspect evidence
Sales caller / Own assigned prospects / illustrated in the preceding screen
FINVERSE WEALTH / CRM INTERFACE PROPOSAL / 26 SEP 2026
080
USER ACTION
01
Open an allowed document slot or upload on behalf of the
customer when permitted.
02
Inspect scan status and request review; replace via a new
version if needed.
03
Download only when the role and document policy permit it.
BEFORE IT CAN PROCEED
Check file type, size, malware status and field-level access. Caller cannot self-mark independent
evidence as verified.
SYSTEM COMMIT
Use private storage and short-lived links. Keep version and access audit; enforce the approved
retention policy.
REPORTING CONSEQUENCE
Report requested, received, accepted and rejected evidence separately.
IF IT CANNOT COMPLETE
Rejected evidence shows the reviewer reason and correction path. No hard deletion of evidence
supporting an approved sale.
Implementation contract proposal. Approval limits, product evidence and commercial definitions need Finverse confirmation.

SC-20.text:
SC / MY PIPELINE
SC-20 Submit a conversion for approval
Sales caller / Own assigned prospects / illustrated in the preceding screen
FINVERSE WEALTH / CRM INTERFACE PROPOSAL / 26 SEP 2026
082
USER ACTION
01
Open Submit conversion when required product milestones
are complete.
02
Review amount, evidence and credit allocation.
03
Submit; the record enters Pending conversion and routes to
the eligible superior.
BEFORE IT CAN PROCEED
Require complete evidence, no unresolved blocking exceptions and an independent approver.
Credit splits must total 100%.
SYSTEM COMMIT
Create a versioned approval request. Lock the submitted payload and notify the correct TL or
next independent approver.
REPORTING CONSEQUENCE
Pending submissions do not count as wins. Approved conversion uses its effective event date
and locked attribution.
IF IT CANNOT COMPLETE
Rejected submission returns with precise reasons. The caller corrects and resubmits a new
version without losing history.
Implementation contract proposal. Approval limits, product evidence and commercial definitions need Finverse confirmation.

SC-21.text:
SC / MY PIPELINE
SC-21 Mark a lead lost with a useful reason
Sales caller / Own assigned prospects / illustrated in the preceding screen
FINVERSE WEALTH / CRM INTERFACE PROPOSAL / 26 SEP 2026
084
USER ACTION
01
Select Mark lost from the lead record.
02
Choose a structured reason and add relevant context.
03
Confirm loss; an opt-out request must also update contact
suppression immediately.
BEFORE IT CAN PROCEED
Loss requires an allowed reason. Duplicate and invalid-data cases use their own dispositions
rather than inflating sales losses.
SYSTEM COMMIT
Append loss event and cancel obsolete sales tasks. Preserve conversation and ownership
history.
REPORTING CONSEQUENCE
Loss analysis groups by product, reason, source and event-time hierarchy. Cohort metrics
preserve their defined denominator.
IF IT CANNOT COMPLETE
Converted records cannot be changed to Lost by the caller. Use a cancellation/refund request to
protect financial history.
Implementation contract proposal. Approval limits, product evidence and commercial definitions need Finverse confirmation.

SC-22.text:
SC / MY PIPELINE
SC-22 Request a lost opportunity to be reopened
Sales caller / Own assigned prospects / illustrated in the preceding screen
FINVERSE WEALTH / CRM INTERFACE PROPOSAL / 26 SEP 2026
086
USER ACTION
01
Open permitted lost history and select Request reopen.
02
Explain the new customer signal and next action.
03
Submit to TL; work resumes only after approval and current
ownership confirmation.
BEFORE IT CAN PROCEED
Contact suppression remains binding. A new product or independent enquiry may need a linked
new opportunity instead.
SYSTEM COMMIT
Create reopen approval and preserve the original loss event. On approval, append a reopen event
and create a task.
REPORTING CONSEQUENCE
Report reopen counts separately. Reopening does not create another first-assigned lead in the
same cohort.
IF IT CANNOT COMPLETE
Old lead outside current scope: send a reference-only request through support; do not reveal its
customer details.
Implementation contract proposal. Approval limits, product evidence and commercial definitions need Finverse confirmation.

SC-23.text:
SC / LEAD INBOX
SC-23 Request a handoff or cross-vertical referral
Sales caller / Own assigned prospects / illustrated in the preceding screen
FINVERSE WEALTH / CRM INTERFACE PROPOSAL / 26 SEP 2026
088
USER ACTION
01
Select Request handoff or Refer enquiry.
02
Provide reason, approved destination and customer
permission.
03
Submit; keep working only on the current authorised
responsibility until acceptance.
BEFORE IT CAN PROCEED
Caller cannot browse destination staff or vertical data. Cross-vertical referral creates a scoped
linked enquiry, not shared ownership.
SYSTEM COMMIT
Notify receiving authority, record accept/decline and handoff deadline. Move tasks only for an
approved same-enquiry transfer.
REPORTING CONSEQUENCE
Earlier activities stay with the original actor. Referral credit, if used, is separately configured and
cannot duplicate revenue.
IF IT CANNOT COMPLETE
Declined referral returns with reason. The sender sees handoff status, not the receiving vertical
workspace.
Implementation contract proposal. Approval limits, product evidence and commercial definitions need Finverse confirmation.

SC-24.text:
SC / CONVERSATIONS
SC-24 Record an opt-out or contact complaint
Sales caller / Own assigned prospects / illustrated in the preceding screen
FINVERSE WEALTH / CRM INTERFACE PROPOSAL / 26 SEP 2026
090
USER ACTION
01
Select Contact preferences or Record complaint
immediately.
02
Capture the exact request and affected channels.
03
Save suppression and raise a complaint task if resolution is
needed.
BEFORE IT CAN PROCEED
An explicit opt-out takes effect immediately and needs no sales approval. Broader contact
restrictions override campaign settings.
SYSTEM COMMIT
Update suppression, cancel queued outbound messages and notify the current owner. Link
complaint to an accountable resolution queue.
REPORTING CONSEQUENCE
Suppressed contacts are visible as a separate operational category. Users cannot erase opt-out
to improve reachability.
IF IT CANNOT COMPLETE
Conflicting channel evidence is reviewed by the policy owner; outreach remains blocked for the
disputed channel.
Implementation contract proposal. Approval limits, product evidence and commercial definitions need Finverse confirmation.

SC-25.text:
SC / PERFORMANCE
SC-25 Inspect personal performance and its calculation
Sales caller / Own assigned prospects / illustrated in the preceding screen
FINVERSE WEALTH / CRM INTERFACE PROPOSAL / 26 SEP 2026
092
USER ACTION
01
Open Performance and choose period and metric.
02
Select a KPI to inspect its formula, numerator, denominator
and eligible evidence.
03
Switch to permitted career history for prior roles without
opening a previous role interface.
BEFORE IT CAN PROCEED
Personal facts stay tied to the employee. Current-team and event-time performance are clearly
separated; zero targets show N/A.
SYSTEM COMMIT
Query versioned metric facts using period timezone and cutoff. Mask historical customer details
outside current scope.
REPORTING CONSEQUENCE
Show verified/manual activity, transfers received, targets, wins, credited revenue and last refresh
independently.
IF IT CANNOT COMPLETE
Late evidence displays a revised report version. Open finance periods remain provisional and
visibly labelled.
Implementation contract proposal. Approval limits, product evidence and commercial definitions need Finverse confirmation.

SC-26.text:
SC / REVIEWS & HELP
SC-26 Prepare for and acknowledge a one-to-one
Sales caller / Own assigned prospects / illustrated in the preceding screen
FINVERSE WEALTH / CRM INTERFACE PROPOSAL / 26 SEP 2026
094
USER ACTION
01
Open an assigned review and complete self-reflection.
02
During the meeting review the frozen scorecard and agree
action items.
03
Acknowledge receipt and add a response; track each
commitment until completed.
BEFORE IT CAN PROCEED
Acknowledgement is not agreement. Employee cannot alter the reviewer rating or see private
restricted reviewer notes.
SYSTEM COMMIT
Version review content, store acknowledgement time and create follow-up tasks. Record
changes after the meeting.
REPORTING CONSEQUENCE
Review completion and commitment closure appear in the permitted coaching report, separate
from sales results.
IF IT CANNOT COMPLETE
Disputed metric: submit a correction request linked to the evidence. Do not overwrite the meeting
snapshot silently.
Implementation contract proposal. Approval limits, product evidence and commercial definitions need Finverse confirmation.

SC-27.text:
SC / PERFORMANCE
SC-27 Generate a personal meeting PDF
Sales caller / Own assigned prospects / illustrated in the preceding screen
FINVERSE WEALTH / CRM INTERFACE PROPOSAL / 26 SEP 2026
096
USER ACTION
01
Choose Export PDF and review the included sections.
02
Generate the pack and wait for Ready, or inspect failure
details.
03
Download from the authenticated report centre; sharing
follows the approved recipient rules.
BEFORE IT CAN PROCEED
Caller can export only permitted personal data. Recheck scope at generation and download;
minimise prospect identifiers.
SYSTEM COMMIT
Create export job with snapshot, recipient, expiry and audit. Watermark the file and revoke
pending jobs after access changes.
REPORTING CONSEQUENCE
PDF stores metric version, cutoff and period. It must reconcile with the selected on-screen
snapshot.
IF IT CANNOT COMPLETE
Access revoked before download: deny the file. Downloaded copies cannot be technically
recalled.
Implementation contract proposal. Approval limits, product evidence and commercial definitions need Finverse confirmation.

SC-28.text:
SC / REVIEWS & HELP
SC-28 Raise a blocker or request a metric correction
Sales caller / Own assigned prospects / illustrated in the preceding screen
FINVERSE WEALTH / CRM INTERFACE PROPOSAL / 26 SEP 2026
098
USER ACTION
01
Open Help or Raise issue on the affected record.
02
Describe the blocker and attach permitted evidence.
03
Submit, track response and confirm resolution without
editing protected facts directly.
BEFORE IT CAN PROCEED
Request must reference a record the caller may identify. Attachment and text rules prevent
unauthorised cross-team disclosure.
SYSTEM COMMIT
Route to TL, operations, finance or access support by category. Record owner, SLA, decisions
and correction linkage.
REPORTING CONSEQUENCE
Accepted corrections append an adjustment or revised fact and retain the prior report version.
IF IT CANNOT COMPLETE
Urgent access issue goes to Super Admin. A pending dispute never grants temporary access to
another dashboard.
Implementation contract proposal. Approval limits, product evidence and commercial definitions need Finverse confirmation.
